description: Show the connected DCAST account: who it is (display name, public handle, the public address of its channel, brand), the plan, granted access scope and permissions, and how many videos and streams it has. Without the billing area the plan and saleBounds are left out and the rest is still returned. Use channelUrl and watchUrl from tool answers as the public addresses; never guess them.
name: get_account
title: Get my DCAST account
